priorityReason: PR #1415 and #1416 still fail Governance after PR #1428 because the renderer passes the claim gate but receives no project identity for historical claimless PRs.
dependencies: existing single PR Decision Evidence Reconciler
boundaries: No relaxation of new Agent PR claim requirement
Claimless bootstrap metadata must be recovered only from internally consistent existing PR evidence
Matching productive project label is required; additional cross-cutting project labels are allowed

exitEvidence: Bootstrap snapshot binds project identity from consistent title/body/label evidence.
Owner/PVC evidence is normalized and fails closed if missing, inconsistent or malformed.
Trusted-main renderer receives PR_PROJECT_ID, PR_PRIMARY_OWNER and PR_AFFECTED_PVC only for the bounded bootstrap path.
No second writer or merge authority is created.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
